## The merge gate caught what two reviews missed

Required checks were **red** on `8766569c`. `docs/briefs/delivered/` emptied when brief 001 was archived; git does not track empty directories, so a fresh CI checkout had no such directory and two documents linking into it broke.

Locally it passed — the empty directory was still on disk. **The `56 tests OK` cited in the previous version of this body was itself a false pass.**

Fixed twice over: `delivered/` gains a README so the directory survives a checkout, and `test_docs_consistency.py`'s link check now resolves against `git ls-files` rather than the working tree, so a local run agrees with a fresh clone. Verified by untracking that README and watching the suite reproduce CI's exact two failures locally.
